content.short: Upscale is a decentralized trading and evaluation platform on TON for professional prop trading.
content.description: Upscale Finance is an innovative decentralized trading platform integrated with the TON blockchain and Telegram ecosystem. It specializes in financial evaluation 'challenges' where traders can demonstrate their skills in a simulated environment to earn access to funded prop trading accounts. Upscale targets the professional trading niche, providing a secure and transparent path for talented individuals to enter the markets. By supporting payments in TON and Telegram Stars, Upscale makes professional financial evaluations highly accessible to the massive global audience of the Telegram platform.
content.meta: Prove your trading skills and get funded with Upscale Finance on TON. Explore on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
